description: Design System Uplift — apply dark zinc/emerald visual design from design/design.html across the entire app using the existing shadcn HSL variable format

userStories.title: Dark-first token foundation in index.css
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the CSS token layer to be permanently dark so all components inherit the correct zinc/emerald palette without a .dark toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Drop the light :root block entirely; zinc-950 dark values become the single :root
Remove the .dark block
Add Google Fonts import for Inter and JetBrains Mono
Add dotted grid background pattern to body (radial-gradient at 32px, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px, 32px 32px)
--foreground: 0 0% 98% (#fafafa zinc-50)
--muted-foreground: 240 4.4% 64.9% (#a1a1aa zinc-400)
--primary: 160 84% 39.4% (#10b981 emerald)
--primary-foreground: 160 68% 60% (#34d399 emerald-hi)
Add custom vars in :root: --emerald-glow, --shadow-card, --shadow-window, --shadow-glow-ok, --shadow-glow-pending, --ring-selected, --bg-canvas, --amber, --amber-hi, --danger, --font-mono
All existing canvas-specific rules (handles, edges, z-index, cursors) are untouched
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update design.html to use shadcn HSL vars
userStories.description: As a developer, I need design/design.html to reference shadcn HSL vars so it is a live spec that renders identically to the app.
acceptanceCriteria: All hex named vars (--bg, --surface, --border, --text, --emerald, etc.) in design.html <style> are replaced with hsl(var(--background)), hsl(var(--card)), hsl(var(--border)), hsl(var(--foreground)), hsl(var(--primary)), etc.
Custom vars that have no shadcn equivalent (--shadow-card, --emerald-glow, etc.) remain as-is
The design.html file imports the same Google Fonts (Inter + JetBrains Mono) as the app
design.html visual output is unchanged — same dark zinc/emerald appearance
Typecheck passes
